summary: Feature request to support fallback/default TLS configuration for remote cluster connections. Currently, unmapped hostnames fall back to insecure plaintext connections instead of using a default configuration, and adding new remote clusters requires manual config updates and cluster restarts.
userImpact: Users adding new remote clusters must manually update configuration and restart the cluster; unmapped clusters silently fall back to insecure connections.
rootCause: GetRemoteClusterClientConfig() lacks fallback logic—unmapped hostnames return nil instead of using a default/wildcard entry, resulting in insecure connections.
proposedFix: Support a reserved key (e.g., '*' or 'defaultRemoteCluster') in the TLS remote clusters configuration that provides a fallback when no exact hostname match is found.
keyQuote: If a hostname is not present in the map, GetRemoteClusterClientConfig returns nil, resulting in a plaintext (insecure) connection
